classification.difficultyReason: Relate the sharp decline between January counts to the preceding July bushfire, then extend a plausible recent growth trend to predict when the population reaches 20 000.

content.prompt: The column graph below shows the number of koalas on Bandicoot Island for the years 1996 to 2005. The population is recorded on 1 January of each year. A large bushfire occurred in July of a particular year.

spec.description: Column graph with all ten years, population scale in thousands, major horizontal gridlines every 5 and minor horizontal gridlines every 1. Alternating source colours distinguish no additional variable and are normalised to one house blue series.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied bars and labels remain visible in the question edition.

children.label: a
children.prompt: in which year the population of koalas was:

answer.worked: The tallest column is for 2001, when the population was 27 000 koalas.
The shortest column is for 2002, when the population was 8000 koalas.

children.label: b
children.prompt: in which year you think the bushfire occurred

answer.worked: The population fell sharply between 1 January 2001 and 1 January 2002. The bushfire most likely occurred in July 2001.

inlines.text: It is considered that the island’s vegetation is able to sustain a population of 20 000 koalas.

children.label: c
children.prompt: For how many years was the population above 20 000?

answer.worked: The columns exceed 20 000 in 2000 and 2001, so the population was above 20 000 for 2 years.

children.label: d
children.prompt: How far above 20 000 was the highest population?

answer.worked:
The highest population was 27 000 koalas.

$$27\,000-20\,000=7000$$

The highest population was 7000 koalas above 20 000.

children.label: e
children.prompt: How far below 20 000 was the lowest population?

answer.worked:
The lowest population was 8000 koalas.

$$20\,000-8000=12\,000$$

The lowest population was 12 000 koalas below 20 000.

children.label: f
children.prompt: In which year would you expect the population to next reach 20 000?

answer.short:
2006 or 2007.

A prediction depends on how the recent growth continues.
answer.worked: The population increased from 9000 in 2003 to 12 000 in 2004 and 15 000 in 2005. Continuing the recent increase of about 3000 koalas each year gives about 18 000 in 2006 and 21 000 in 2007, so 2007 is a reasonable prediction. A prediction of 2006 is also accepted if growth accelerates.
